P18_01_trim_backer_coplanar.scope: 8 explicit current Trim→TrimBacker object-name pairs, exact horizontal/vertical cap planes
P18_01_trim_backer_coplanar.method: Actual OBJ v+f parser, triangle normal/winding classification, coplanar plane match, convex 2D polygon clipping and sum of 8 paired projected overlap areas.
P18_01_trim_backer_coplanar.caveat: Does not imply global absence of all z-fighting or full Blender importer equivalence.

P18_seven_disconnected_source_parts.method: Actual indexed OBJ part meshes; per named component bounding AABB minimum Euclidean separation to all other authoring OBJ parts. Positive AABB distance mathematically proves non-contact; zero or negative AABB broadphase distance only identifies an eligible contact candidate.
P18_seven_disconnected_source_parts.caveat: AABB overlap is NOT a triangle contact proof; C01-12 independently reports exact 72 triangle crossings for all seven, but this C01-10 result itself is AABB-level.

P18_03_wheels_vs_posts.method: Read actual complete 53-object OBJ source, extract 4 wheel and 4 upright indexed triangles, apply exact object vertex coordinates in meters. Moller-Trumbore segment-triangle face intersection both directions on 4 expected wheel/post pairs.
P18_03_wheels_vs_posts.caveat: Does not test 360-degree swept animation, physically contained volume overlap, Unity PhysX contacts or target Blender FBX.
